transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Aeroporto-Guarulhos station is on CPTM line 13-Jade, which connects the airport with Engenheiro Goulart station. At Engenheiro Goulart, passengers can transfer to line 12-Safira. The airport-side entrance is next to the Terminal 1 car park.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Malex luggage storage is available in Terminals 2 and 3 outside the arrivals area, on the sidewalk. The Terminal 2 Arrival West location is open round the clock. The Terminal 2 Arrival East and Terminal 3 Arrival locations are open from 07:00 to 19:00.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: The airport offers free Wi-Fi through BOINGO. To connect, select .GRU WIFI, press Connect and follow the instructions. BOINGO support is available round the clock on 0800-095-9026.
